### Bio:

My research interests focus on causal inference, missing data analysis, and heterogeneous treatment effects in clinical and population health research. I am interested in understanding how methodological choices impact inference and decision-making in health studies. My work aims to apply statistical modeling, causal methods, and machine learning approaches to study treatment effects and health disparities using both simulated and real-world data.
